problem.title1: The more clients you take on,
problem.lead: You no longer grow at the pace of your talent, but at the pace of your logistics. Each new client adds hours of busywork, not creation.
problem.pain1d: Canva, Notes, the planning spreadsheet, the Instagram app. You copy-paste all day long.
problem.pain2d: Content spills over into your weekends. The more clients you take, the deeper you sink.
problem.pain3t: One voice per client, by hand
problem.pain3d: You keep each brand’s tone in your head. One slip, and the client sees it.
problem.pain4d: Endless back-and-forth, screenshots, lost versions. The post goes out late.
problem.statText: per week per manager, swallowed up juggling tools instead of creating. That’s one more client you’re not taking on.

steps.title1: From raw content to a published post,
steps.lead: KLIP brings together all your social post-production: import your footage, compose your visuals, let AI write, schedule. For every client, without ever leaving the tool.
steps.s1d: Drop in a client’s photos and videos — all your material gathered in one place.
steps.s2d: Create your visuals or rework your imports in the built-in editor, Canva-style. The client’s brand kit is already applied.
steps.s3d: Captions, descriptions and hashtags generated from the image and the client’s brand voice.
steps.s4d: Slot it on the calendar, get it approved, KLIP publishes to Instagram — for each of your clients.

showcase.lead: Designed to manage six brands without ever mixing them up. Here’s what a workday without friction looks like.
showcase.editorTitle: Each client’s brand kit, applied in one click
showcase.editorText: Select some text and it all opens up — font, size, brand colors, effects, animations. The same power as Canva or the Adobe suite, already set to your client.
showcase.calDesc: Every post from every client on a single grid. Drag to reschedule, spot the gaps, keep the rhythm — no spreadsheet.
showcase.queueDesc: Your Instagram accounts connected. You approve, KLIP publishes at the scheduled slot — no need to reopen the app or post by hand.

features.title1: What used to take ten tools,
features.mainText: Each client’s brand kit — colors, type, logo — applied in one click. You drag the text, it’s pixel-perfect. No design software to open anymore.
features.f1d: Tone, style, banned words. Every generation respects the client’s DNA.
features.f2d: Captions and hashtags generated from the photo and the brand’s context.
features.f3d: Brand kit, history, connected accounts — siloed, never mixed.
features.f4d: Connect a pro account. Schedule, approve, KLIP publishes at the slot.

testimonials.bigQ: Before, my production ran across Canva, a Drive, email back-and-forth and a planning spreadsheet. Now it’s all in one place. I got my Friday afternoons back.
testimonials.s1q: The AI picks up the exact tone of each brand. I tweak two or three words instead of rewriting everything.
testimonials.s2q: My clients approve from their phone, without creating an account. No more screenshots on WhatsApp.

pricing.lead: 7-day free trial. Change plans whenever you want.

faq.q1: Do I need to already have a pro Instagram account?
faq.a1: Yes. KLIP connects to a professional or creator Instagram account via the official API. Connecting takes two minutes, per client.
faq.q2: Does the AI really respect each brand’s voice?
faq.a2: You define the tone, style and banned words for each client once. Every generation draws on that voice — you stay in control and refine in one click.
faq.q3: Can my clients approve without a KLIP account?
faq.a3: Yes. You send an approval link: the client approves or comments directly, with nothing to install. No more email back-and-forth.
faq.a4: Each client has its own space: brand kit, history, connected accounts. Nothing is ever mixed between two brands.
faq.q5: Can I change plans along the way?
faq.a5: Anytime, no commitment. You move up a tier when you take on more clients, and back down if needed.
